Recently Deleted behavior vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Photos trash retention on device covers storefront language. PhotoKit, deletion flows, and Connect actually separate in-app trash behavior from product-page copy:

  • Recently Deleted album — Photos → Albums → Recently Deleted holds deleted photos and videos for a limited retention window before permanent removal. Controls runtime trash behavior — not App Store language. AppLocale does not perform this.
  • Recover deleted items — user-facing action to restore a photo or video from Recently Deleted back to the library. Listing copy may mention recover flows; implementing PHAsset recovery or trash queries is engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • Permanently delete & empty trash — delete individual items from Recently Deleted or empty the entire album before the retention window expires. Product-page copy should describe that workflow; building permanent-delete APIs is in-app engineering.
  • 30-day retention countdown — days-remaining badges on trash items. Gallery overlays should name the countdown in zh-Hans when your English frames show retention timers — not English-only "X days left" pasted through machine translation.
  • Hidden album (different surface) — hide photos from the library without Recently Deleted trash semantics. Related buyer vocabulary (隐藏相册, 隐藏的项目) but not the same product story — do not paste Hidden album copy onto Recently Deleted hero frames.
  • Locked Folder (different surface) — passcode-protected private photo vault behind Face ID or Touch ID. Mention only as contrast — not the Recently Deleted trash hero. See Locked Folder listing (zh-Hans).
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of Recently Deleted support in the binary.

Working Recently Deleted integration and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Recently Deleted, recover deleted photos, and 最近删除 value on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you wire trash-recovery APIs in code.

Recently Deleted–specific listing copy — what translates differently

Trash-album and photo-recovery listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe Apple's Recently Deleted feature — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Recently Deleted phrasing

US pages use "Recently Deleted", "Recover deleted photos", "Permanently delete", "Empty Recently Deleted", "30-day trash", or "Restore deleted items." Apple's Simplified Chinese Photos vocabulary often uses 最近删除 for the album name, 最近删除的项目 for deleted-item grids, 恢复已删除的照片 for recover-deleted-photos callouts, 永久删除 for permanent removal, and 清空最近删除 for empty-trash actions. AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing recovery capabilities your app does not support.

Recover vs permanently delete vs empty trash

Screenshot overlays differ by action — tap Recover on one item, Permanently delete on another, or Delete All to empty the album. Chinese buyers expect concise action labels on gallery frames: 恢复 for recover, 永久删除 for permanent delete, 全部删除 or 清空最近删除 for empty-trash marketing. Mixing English "Recover" with Chinese body copy on the same frame looks inconsistent.

Retention countdown vs static trash grid

Many Recently Deleted marketing screenshots show days-remaining badges on deleted items. zh-Hans caption lines should name the countdown the frame shows: 剩余 X 天 for days left, 30 天内可恢复 for recover-within-window marketing — not English "X days left" pasted through machine translation.

Do not conflate with Hidden album or Locked Folder

Recently Deleted is a trash album with recover-or-delete semantics. Hidden album hides items from the main library — different buyer promise. Locked Folder locks private media behind biometrics — not trash recovery. If your app supports multiple surfaces, scope each screenshot frame accurately.

Do not conflate with Clean Up or Duplicates

Clean Up removes unwanted objects from inside photos — see Clean Up listing (zh-Hans). Duplicates merge near-identical library items — a separate album workflow. Recently Deleted recovers or permanently removes deleted items from the trash album — different screenshot vocabulary on the same product page.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need trash-recovery search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 最近删除, 恢复已删除的照片, 最近删除的项目, and 永久删除 each signal different intent from Locked Folder vault keywords or Clean Up object-removal keywords.
